shared_elements: circles / discs and concentric ring motifs
rows of repeated oval elements along curved bands
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by curvilinear outlines punctuated by rows of discs or ovals set along sweeping bands, and both reduce a body to schematic outlined zones rather than modelled anatomy. However, A is a weathered, vertically symmetrical relief on a massive three-dimensional block with a frontal/dorsal layout, while B is a crisp two-dimensional line drawing of a single horizontal profile figure with an outstretched feathered limb, so the compositional logic and rendering medium have little in common.
